[[Shadow of Death]] is a [[Nightmare]] boss that appears in [[Black Curtain]].
==Locations==
*[[Kryta]]
**{{NPC location|The Black Curtain}}

==Skills==
14 [[Blood Magic]], 16 [[Death Magic]] (20 Blood Magic, 20 Death Magic in [[Hard mode]])
*{{skill icon|Dark Aura}}
*{{skill icon|Life Siphon}}
*{{skill icon|Mark of Subversion}}
*{{skill icon|Touch of Agony}}

==Items dropped==
*[[Shadowy Remnants]]
*[[Pile of Glittering Dust]]

==Notes==
*This boss is one of six that the [[Krytan Herald]] at the [[Temple of the Ages]] warns about. All six bosses have levels that are much higher than the other foes in the area.

== Trivia ==
{{disputed}}
*The name of this boss might be a reference to [[w:Psalm 23|Psalm 23:4]].
